bio.text: Chuong Vo is the Republican candidate for California's 45th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He worked as a law enforcement officer with the Torrance Police Department from 1999 to 2025 and served on the executive board of the California Joint Powers Insurance Authority from 2021 to 2025.
According to his campaign website, he is a former Mayor of Cerritos and a 28-year law-enforcement officer.
